messages:
Jo: quick note from today's console pass — the action strip on list rows looks visually unbalanced in compact mode. primary feels squished next to the overflow chevron.
Nadia: can you share the current tokens? curious if it's gap or button padding.
Jo: current tokens in compact: --action-gap: 10px; --button-pad-x: 8px; icons use 20px touch area. suggestion: drop action-gap to 6px and increase button-pad-x to 10px so the controls breathe but row density stays.
Evan: lowering gap but increasing pad seems OK if overall cell width doesn't grow. does that affect table column alignment?
Jo: i tested in figma — columns stable. change is inside the action cluster only. snippet:
```
--action-gap-compact: 6px;
--button-pad-x-compact: 10px;
.row .actions { gap: var(--action-gap-compact); }
.row .btn { padding-inline: var(--button-pad-x-compact); }
```
Pri: accessibility nit — with smaller gaps the separation between primary and ghost is less distinct. propose using a subtle divider token between primary and secondary when gap < 8px: `.actions .primary + .secondary { padding-left:6px; border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle); }`.
Nadia: agree on divider. also copy nit: overflow menu label shows "Options" on some locales; prefer "More actions" for clarity.
Evan: toast collision note — when a toast appears top-right it briefly hits the action strip on narrow widths. can we bias toasts away from top-right on lists, or add a 12px top margin to the list when a toast is present?
Jo: i'd rather change toast placement for list pages to top-center so they don't overlap action strips at all. rule: `.page.list .toast-container { top: 12px; right: 50%; transform: translateX(50%); }` — works well for short toasts.
Pri: ensure toasts still announce with aria-live="polite". and when we move them, screen readers should get the correct context.
frontend-bot: accessibility scan queued. Results: Divider contrast passes at 4.5:1. Focus ring on compact buttons should be 2px to remain visible when gap reduced. Toast relocation to top-center ok but recommend `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"` and ensure toasts do not steal focus. :white_check_mark:
Jo: action list: 1) apply --action-gap-compact = 6px and --button-pad-x-compact = 10px, 2) add divider between primary and secondary when gap small, 3) change overflow label to "More actions", 4) relocate list toasts to top-center and keep aria-live polite, 5) bump compact focus ring to 2px. i'll update figma and open a small PR for tokens.
Nadia: please also run a quick responsive check for rows with many inline chips — reduced gap can still look cluttered there.
Jo: will do. posting figma link once updated. thanks :thumbsup:
